title: MetaArgs
summary: Data and URL information passed to a metadata function.

sections.title: Contract
sections.body: Provides data and loaderData aliases for the active route loader result, plus error, params, and location: URL. The generic uses RouteData<T>. Both data fields may be undefined.

sections.title: Usage and limits
sections.body: Handle missing data and route errors. Root metadata used as a fallback receives the active snapshot arguments, not a separate root loader result.
